video.title: Infinite Scroll, Prefetching & Debounce | Day 226
video.description:
Learn to explain how a list keeps loading as the user scrolls without waste: Infinite Scroll, Prefetching & Debounce, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Infinite Scroll - A list that loads more items on its own when the user scrolls near the end.
Prefetching - Loading data for rows that are about to appear, before the user scrolls to them.
Debounce - Waiting until the input stops for a moment before you act, so you do not fire too often.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: iOS Infinite Scroll, Prefetching & Debounce | Day 226
landscape.description:
Explain Infinite Scroll, Prefetching & Debounce in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Infinite Scroll, Prefetching, Debounce 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Infinite Scroll - A list that loads more items on its own when the user scrolls near the end.
한국어: Infinite Scroll: 사용자가 끝 근처까지 스크롤하면 스스로 항목을 더 불러오는 목록

Prefetching - Loading data for rows that are about to appear, before the user scrolls to them.
한국어: Prefetching: 사용자가 스크롤하기 전에 곧 나타날 행의 데이터를 미리 불러오는 것

Debounce - Waiting until the input stops for a moment before you act, so you do not fire too often.
한국어: Debounce: 너무 자주 실행되지 않도록 입력이 잠시 멈출 때까지 기다렸다가 동작하는 것

In this video, Mina and Jake talk about how a list keeps loading as the user scrolls without waste, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Can you explain Infinite Scroll, Prefetching and Debounce in English?

dialogue.title: Too many requests
dialogue.setting: Fixing a feed that loads too often

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the feed should keep loading as the user scrolls.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is infinite scroll. When the last row appears, load more items.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Like `onAppear` in our code, when `n` is the last item?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. But the user waits at the bottom while it loads.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use prefetching. It loads the next rows before the user reaches them.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. But now we send the same request many times.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The `onAppear` call fires again and again when the user scrolls fast.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add a debounce. In our code, `last` and the half second wait do that.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So a debounce skips the extra calls.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Infinite scroll, prefetching and a debounce work well together.
The feed uses infinite scroll, so there is no next button.
